youtube_title: Stand Up Fast And See Black? Your Blood Lags Behind | Body Fix #31 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #31. Jumped out of bed... and everything went BLACK for a second?
B is right. Blood pressure DIPS for a moment. Blood stays in your legs, brain gets a bit less.
More likely when you're dehydrated, skipped meals, or stood up too fast.
Fix: Sit first, stand slowly, flex your calves, drink water, don't skip meals.
Red flags: You faint, chest pain, palpitations, or it happens often? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Low blood pressure (postural)
